key_concepts: Substances are classified into elements and compounds
Elements and compounds differ in composition
Compounds are represented by chemical formulas
A chemical formula shows the atoms found in a compound
Water is a compound with the formula H2O
Water contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom
Water is a vital compound used for drinking, cleaning, washing, and cooking
Nitrate, citric acid, fructose, guanine, and caffeine are examples of compounds
Food labels list ingredients that contain chemical compounds and essential elements
Elements and compounds are essential in daily life
